description: Cooperative local input, version 1 (docs/51 §4.6): the host keeps their own mouse and keyboard and has priority; local activity yields remote input (nonterminal), readiness is decided only by the endpoint, and only fresh helper input after the readiness barrier is injected. Terminal transitions are unchanged.
contract: palisade.assist.control v2 + feature localYield; palisade.assist.native.ext v3
rules: The endpoint declares localYield; the helper opts in on each peer with input-barrier {epoch: 0} before any input. A peer whose first input has no opt-in is legacy: local input ends remote input as before.

Local activity, a local press or release yields: a new epoch from active or ready, the same epoch while yielded. The helper's owned input is released, except what the local person also holds (handed over: never released by the endpoint).

Readiness needs: no local key or button held, 2000 ms without local events, the endpoint's own cleanup complete, and unchanged authority since the yield began. Any authority change while yielded or ready is terminal.

After ready the endpoint drops every non-release input until input-barrier for that epoch; a barrier for another epoch is stale-epoch. Releases are always applied; after a yield nothing is owned, so they inject nothing.

input-barrier t repeats the last input t the helper sent on this peer (0 before any), so t never decreases; the endpoint's age guard (docs/51 §4.4) treats the barrier like a release: replay-checked, never dropped as stale.

Stop, revocation, lock, protected desktop, sensitive native UI, source/peer/lease loss, expiry, replacement and stream end are terminal exactly as before; yield never extends the deadline, broadens a capability, changes the controller or restores ended authority.
